Anthropic says Claude Fable 5 will be included in Max and Team Premium plans at 50% of limits from July 20 and via usage credits for Pro and Team Standard users   —  Beginning July 20, Claude Fable 5 will be included in all Max and Team Premium plans, at 50% of limits.
